title: One Punch Man
source: One Punch Man manga by ONE and Yusuke Murata (ongoing). Snapshots use the latest published arc.
world: Saitama became so strong from a simple daily routine that he beats any enemy with one punch, which leaves him bored. He joins the Hero Association with his cyborg disciple Genos and climbs the ranks while nobody believes how strong he is. Monsters, the Monster Association and the hero-hunter Garou threaten the cities. A parody of superhero stories that is also a real action story.
power_system: No real system: heroes have powers, tech or martial arts. Disaster levels rank threats: Wolf, Tiger, Demon, Dragon and God. Saitama's strength came from 100 push-ups, 100 sit-ups, 100 squats and a 10 km run every day.
